tickets.title: Prepare refinance and reset comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison for Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk of keeping the adjustable mortgage after the reset, using the fixed-rate refinance quote, and combining or leaving the Teacup Comet Bank HELOC separate, including payment estimates, closing costs, and cash reserve impact.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2025-01-24.

tickets.title: Collect missing refinance documents
tickets.text: Collect the missing items from Silver Marmot Mortgage's checklist for the Nettlewhisks' refinance file: Liora's current pay stub, Jonah's year-to-date profit-and-loss statement, the most recent business bank statement, and a complete prior-year tax return packet.

tickets.title: Resolve mortgage payoff balance discrepancy

tickets.text: Restore Teacup Comet Bank portal access for Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk so recent HELOC and checking statements are available for Silver Marmot Mortgage lender review. Two-factor prompts are going to Jonah's old phone number and bank statement exports failed during the call.

tickets.title: Model cash-flow stress test for debt repayment
tickets.text: Build a cash-flow stress test for Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk modeling the mortgage reset payment, Teacup Comet Bank HELOC interest, credit card payoff target, Eleni's school costs, and Hazel Willowdoodle's possible voluntary support amount against monthly income and spending.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position
tickets.text: Assess position size, tax basis, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, trading restrictions, and diversification options before recommending any action. Apply this to the Clockwork Clover Systems stock position in the Nettlewhisks' joint taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody (~$156,000 market value, ~$42,000 cost basis) and compare partial sale, staged sale, pledged-asset alternatives, and no-sale options for debt reduction.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to compare partial sale, staged sale, pledged-asset alternatives, and no-sale options for debt reduction by 2025-02-03.

tickets.title: Address appraisal and rate-lock readiness items
tickets.text: Collect the insurance declarations, property tax bill, and HOA confirmation for the Nettlewhisks' primary residence to satisfy Silver Marmot Mortgage's appraisal checklist and rate-lock window before underwriting review.

tickets.title: Show non-retirement funding options for debt restructuring
tickets.text: Prepare a planning analysis for Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk showing non-retirement funding options for debt restructuring before any retirement-account cash-flow scenario, per Liora's direction that IRA or 401(k) withdrawals should be treated only as a last-resort scenario.
